notes: ROS builder on a Stream Deck. Companion module 1.0.5 adds a ROS builder group: OPEN BUILDER, + CUE, + WITH, + SECTION, DUP ROW, MOVE ▲ ▼, ROW ▲ ▼, SAVE and PRINT. They act on the builder's current row, now marked gold at its left edge (the one last clicked, added or moved). No delete button on purpose. Re-import the module from StandBy › Save Companion Module to Downloads. Easier to find in the ROS builder: each row's ↑ ↓ + ✕ buttons are bigger and stay pinned at the right edge, and the column titles are bigger.
